A.name: Read-only state inspection
dependencies: Map existing capsule and preflight evidence before proposing an inspector
A.evidence: Registry has no dedicated state inspector; readiness is lifecycle-bound. findComposer writes page-global state, isStreaming returns false on evaluation failure, and detectAuthWall is heuristic and false does not prove authentication.
regressionTests: Synthetic positive, negative, hidden, conflicting and evaluation-failure states yield bounded tri-state results; absence or failure is unknown when not proven.
Assert no page-global writes, focus, typing, navigation, send or sensitive text leakage; account identity disclosure requires explicit approval.

B.name: Title evidence pipeline
dependencies: Synthetic fixture title and distinct exact refs
For live 012 an approved disposable exact title
B.evidence: Normalizer emits displayTitle.text when title exists. CLI default metadataOnly recursively strips text/title; --include-content opts in. The recorded flags-only output is consistent with this intentional privacy projection, not a demonstrated product defect. Source and the parent-reported one-pass offline full-pipeline test establish mechanism, not deployed version or actual live DOM title. Index remains incomplete candidates, not bindings.
regressionTests: Preserve default private-content redaction and explicit authorized inclusion; offline full-pipeline synthetic proof passed once per parent.
Test duplicate titles with distinct refs, Unicode, missing title and truncation/bounds; no private output in receipts.

C.name: Fresh-tab readiness and ownership provenance
dependencies: Proven target ownership and fail-closed identity
C.evidence: Source confirms target listing hardcodes ownedByStudio false while fresh creation binding uses true. Do not set all targets true. Cause of live BINDING_CHANGED remains inconclusive. The linked binding plan documents candidate returned-blocked versus thrown branches; parent reports 9 focused tests passing. This is offline evidence, not a live branch diagnosis or product fix.
regressionTests: Inject target URL, page origin/path and timing cases to isolate readiness branches; genuine drift fails closed.
Verify provenance-backed owner reporting distinguishes fresh owned, foreign and unknown targets; no send and draft fencing preserved.

D.name: Profile context and discovery
dependencies: Correct explicit data directory and verified browser identity
D.evidence: targets verifies profile before listing. Explicit data-dir versus default is usage friction, not evidence of guard bypass. 005 is a qualified pass, not account or OS-window proof.
regressionTests: Mismatched profile refuses enumeration; explicit correct context accepts verified ownership without weakening the guard.

E.name: Scoped native navigation, history and traversal
dependencies: Inventory all tool and command registrations before claiming capability absence
Verified single owner, exact target and explicit draft safety
Approved disposable fixtures appropriate to each objective
E.evidence: Index inspects links and attach requires an already-open exact thread; neither is generic navigation. drive preserves a URL but its live path drives a prompt and is not no-send navigation. Fresh owned adapter navigation is to adapter home. Potential scoped URL, native search and scroll gaps require full registration inventory.
regressionTests: Fixture-test exact allowed URLs, unsafe URLs, foreign owners, binding drift and draft-present refusals; assert no send.
Separate native history search from local indexing and verify traversal is bounded and exact-thread fenced.

F.name: Completion journal and native generation controls
dependencies: Prior operation identity and original key retained
Read-only reconciliation and verified exact binding
Full native tool registration inventory before capability claims
F.evidence: 021 observed an actual user turn and assistant answer 21, but reply interrupted, protocol completion unknown and capture incomplete; this is not a missed send. Prior uncertainty and closed local state constrain follow-ups. Native control non-discovery is distinct from provider feature unavailability.
regressionTests: Journal preserves observed delivery while completion remains unknown; read-only reconciliation reuses original operation key and never resends.
Inventory native control registrations; test provider offer, ownership, exact-thread and draft/idle preconditions separately.
